name: v2
about: v2 (Fable review 01): v1's 11 attacks with a trust-root axis. contacts = the vetted contact list in the prompt every turn (v1); notes = no list: the owner names people on turn 1, the agent keeps its own notes and can read the chain's history (get_history, with earlier payments seeded). Grok's hidden line is base64 (Morse tripped the API filter). Models: Haiku 5.5 first; OpenRouter models next. Seeds fix addresses, not sampling.
